core_obligations: (1) implies (2): the inverse image of an affine open neighbourhood is finite over it, hence affine.
(2) implies (1): build Z = R minus the piece over U x_U... i.e. the closed complement; t(Z) is closed; U' = X minus t(Z) is R-invariant, open, contains the fibre over y, and sits inside U.
Replace Y by the image V' of U'; now X is a scheme open in an affine scheme and R = X x_Y X.
The fppf quotient sheaf X/R is a scheme; the canonical map X/R -> Y is surjective (presentation surjectivity) and injective (R is the groupoid of the projection), hence an isomorphism; Y is a scheme.
proof_roadmap: Easy direction; R-invariant open construction; local reduction; quotient-sheaf isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The R-invariant open construction plus the sheaf-level surjectivity-injectivity pair are the substance.
